A '''[[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi archaeologist]]''' was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="JA" />. At some point during [[Galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] History the Jedi archaeologist inspected a set of remains on a [[Planet/Legends|world]] with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. They used a lightsaber with a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="JA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cerean Jedi was depicted on the "Jedi Archaeologist" card for [[The Price of Victory]], an expansion set of cards for the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]].<ref name="JA" /> They were illustrated by artist [[Ryan Barger]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref> Most cards of the game depict the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], though exceptions were rare, but still possible. Therefore, it is impossible to determine the time period this Jedi lived in without additional information.
